messages.author: 12f269733c6eb9a2
messages.subject: Re: Decimals and ceros
parts:
Elisa:

If you are using the data import 'wizard' that walks you through the
series of steps necessary to import data from a text file, notice a box
entitled 'Decimal symbol' in Step 4 (where Distance is showing the data
it has found in the text file you specified). There you can either use
the 'regional settings' (default) or you can override the regional
settings (which are set by your operating system) and specify the use of
'.' as the decimal symbol.

My suggestion is that you select '.' to override the regional settings,
and hopefully this will solve you problem.
